patch_description: Add a final Whittaker smoother stage with auto-calibrated λ. Fixed λ fails because the safe window is narrow and signal-dependent. Instead, escalate λ (doubling) from a small λ₀ and stop when the sign-flip count of np.diff(y) stops improving (>5% threshold) or correlation with the pre-polish signal drops below 0.97, keeping the best iterate. This directly attacks slope_changes (20.4) and false_reversals (14.2) while the correlation guard preserves tracking accuracy and lag.
